name: single_add_apply
statement: ι) (m₁ m₂ : M) (b : ι) : single a (m₁ + m₂) b = single a m₁ b + single a m₂ b

name: support_add_single
statement: ι} {b : M} {f : ι →₀ M} (ha : a ∉ f.support) (hb : b ≠ 0) : support (f + single a b) = cons a f.support ha

name: induction_on_max₂
statement: ι →₀ M) (zero : motive 0) (add_single : ∀ a b (f : ι →₀ M), (∀ c ∈ f.support, c < a) → b ≠ 0 → motive f → motive (f + single a b)) : motive f
